approach: Native Windows x64 recompilation with integrated portable asset setup for supported PAL and NTSC-U game media.
notes: Public v1.0.0 release. PAL and NTSC-U asset setup, Disc 1 and Disc 2 import, portable runtime paths, saves, and optional DLC installation are implemented. A complete playthrough has not yet been performed, and the real in-game Disc 1 to Disc 2 transition remains untested.
